space: meshes authored in UE-local space; Max scene holds them mirrored in Y (FBX import maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -y, z))

SM_LARS_Moonpool.note: M-09 Moonpool deck: three welded hex cells (NW, NE, E) around the open hexagonal pool of cell (0, 0); the pool stays open to the south (lane) and west (LARS pier). Status strip, hazard band, fenders, ladder, signal mast

SM_LARS_Base_Deck.note: LARS pier (M-08 base): W cell + SW cell clipped at X -1 230 so the lane stays clear; deck top = arm mount Z (+80), caissons only west of X -1 500, cantilevered boarding edge, doubler plate under the arm pedestal, console, HPU, rails

SM_Pontoon_Hex_A.note: M-01 hex pontoon 1 000 x 1 155 x 200: steel deck plate, Corten ring frame, 10 blue float drums

SM_Pontoon_Hex_Biorock.note: M-02 perimeter pontoon 1 000 x 1 155 x 500: M-01 body + rebar cage with three Biorock reef blocks and Ti anodes

SM_Agro_Beach.note: M-11 beach pontoon 1 000 x 1 155 x 300: sand deck sloping 0 -> -60 toward +X (3.4 deg), Corten hull

SM_Path_Main.note: M-03 arterial deck A400: 400 x 1 200 x 100 (deck 40 on two girders), edge chamfer, luminous edge strips. Long axis = X

SM_Path_Hub.note: M-03 junction plate: hexagon 800 across flats x 40, six A400 decks butt against its sides; luminous hex trace + centre via

SM_Path_Wobbly.note: M-04 scrap bridge 150 x 600 x 30: four patchwork tin sheets on two galvanized pipes. Long axis = X

SM_Path_FloatNode.note: Floating node 200 x 200 x 120 for the M-04 crossings: tin plate on a pipe frame over two blue drums

SM_Path_Rope.note: M-07 suspended bridge 140 x 500 x 200, sag 30: 12 planks on rope stringers, rope handrails 110. End A at the pivot, runs +X

SM_Favela_Box_A.note: M-05 container module 300 x 400 x 300: steel frame, corrugated walls 18, door 90 x 200 on -X, two warm windows, walkable roof

SM_Favela_Tier_B.note: M-06 stacked unit 400 x 600 x 350 (+120 on +X): room 300 x 400 with a covered porch on -X, exterior stair on the -Y strip: flush entry apron (kerb 12), 14 treads (rise 24.1, 42.4 deg), flat top landing 70 deep flush with the roof (Z 350) + roof tab onto the deck, solid parapets on the open sides; roof + balcony strip on +Y with handrail. Stack the next tier rotated 180 deg

SM_Market_Tent.note: M-13 market stall 400 x 400 x 300: four poles, tie bars, peaked parachute-silk canopy (static), pallet counter 300 x 60 x 100, lantern

SM_Agro_AlgaeVat.note: M-10 algae vat D500 x 150: Corten base ring, 8 posts, rim and hoop, opaque luminous liquid (glass wall = SM_Agro_VatGlass)

SM_Agro_VatGlass.note: M-10 glass wall D486 x 126 (thin translucent, non-Nanite, no collision)

SM_RnD_ServerDesk.note: M-12 salvaged server desk 200 x 100 x 200: rack tower with LED rows and an exposed PCB side, tabletop, CRT terminal

SM_Pneumo_Mast.note: M-14 pneumatic-post mast 260 x 260 x 400: octagonal brass shaft with stacking flanges, three neon status rings, hatch on +X

SM_Agro_WindGen.note: M-15 wind generator 200 x 200 x 1 000: base plate, tapering Corten lattice tower, nacelle with a fixed three-blade rotor D180, tail vane, obstruction light
